_comment: Current live on-hardware rig tune (geometry + gains) as applied this session. Re-apply after every battery cycle: python3 tools/apply_tune.py --file rig_tune.json. NOTHING on the FC persists across power cycles. Pitch is a roll-seeded stabilization (stiff inner + slow outer) to break the angle_kp=4.0 cascade runaway; pitch sysid still pending. See memory onhw-sysid-phase0.
airframe: X-quad on a free-rotating rig (raised inertia). Motors: M1,M3 CW, M2,M4 CCW. IMU aligned.

motor_geometry._comment: Spin INVERTED vs firmware default -> flips s_mix_yaw only (default spin-sign was backwards, causing yaw positive feedback). Keeps roll/pitch mix identical. REQUIRED.

rate_pid._comment: controller=1 (rate). roll sysid-tuned; pitch SEEDED from roll (X-quad roll~=pitch inertia) to give a stiff inner loop so the slow outer loop can't cascade -- pitch's own sysid is still pending; yaw firmware default (stable with geometry fix).

angle_pid._comment: controller=0 (angle). roll from sysid loop-shaping; pitch SOFTENED 4.0->1.0 (firmware default 4.0 over the soft inner loop caused the ~300 dps pitch cascade runaway). yaw left at firmware default.

identified_plant._comment: rate-loop plant omega/u = K/(s(tau s + 1)). roll: archived rig chirp (live gains). roll_2: this session's re-chirp (lower R^2; gains NOT applied).

roll.note: archived fit; these gains are the live roll gains above

roll_2.note: 2026-06-22 re-chirp; not applied (u saturation + 80 dropped samples)
